subject.title: fix(desktop): notifications use native macOS and Windows services

question: Should the desktop companion intentionally raise its supported macOS floor from 10.13 to 13.0 in order to adopt this notification backend?
rationale: That compatibility reduction is a product and release decision, not an implementation detail, and the PR does not establish an existing documented macOS 13 baseline.

options.title: Preserve current support
options.body: Keep the existing macOS compatibility floor and adjust, patch, or conditionally select the notification backend so older supported systems still launch.

options.title: Approve macOS 13 minimum
options.body: Accept the platform drop only with explicit release documentation and upgrade proof showing how existing macOS 10.13–12 installations behave.

recommendation.title: Preserve current support
recommendation.body: Keep the existing macOS compatibility floor and adjust, patch, or conditionally select the notification backend so older supported systems still launch.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person to the desktop companion direction and the proposed dependency/platform choices.
